steps.tx: **Diffuse large B-cell** lymphoma DLBCL is the most common non-Hodgkin lymphoma, divided by cell of origin into germinal centre B-cell-like GCB and activated B-cell-like ABC phenotypes. The Hans immunohistochemistry algorithm classifies cases using CD10, BCL6, and MUM1 expression. ABC or non-GCB subtype demonstrates constitutive NF-kappa-B pathway activation and historically poorer outcomes with standard anthracycline-based chemoimmunotherapy.

steps.tx: Chemoimmunotherapy combinations established the curative foundation for aggressive lymphomas. Frontline **R-CHOP** rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisone cures approximately 60% of patients with advanced diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Six cycles administered every 21 days with growth factor support represents the standard regimen, monitoring left ventricular ejection fraction for anthracycline cardiotoxicity and managing tumour lysis syndrome risk.

steps.tx: Antibody-drug conjugates targeting B-cell lineage markers improve frontline event-free survival. **Polatuzumab vedotin** anti-CD79b antibody-drug conjugate substituted for vincristine in Pola-R-CHP significantly improves progression-free survival over R-CHOP in previously untreated DLBCL in POLARIX. The addition of the monomethyl auristatin E MMAE conjugate reduced progression or death risk by twenty-seven percent in intermediate- and high-risk patients.

left.title: Pola-R-CHP (POLARIX Trial)
points: Preferred frontline for IPI 2 to 5 DLBCL

right.title: Standard R-CHOP
points: Curative in approx. 60% of patients overall

steps.tx: Genomic translocations involving oncogenic drivers define refractory high-grade biology. High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and **BCL2** and/or BCL6 rearrangements double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma exhibits an aggressive clinical course resistant to standard R-CHOP. Fluorescence in situ hybridization FISH for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 translocations is mandatory in high-grade morphology, warranting dose-adjusted EPOCH-R instead of R-CHOP.

steps.tx: Prognostic scoring models guide patient counseling and trial stratification. The **International Prognostic Index** IPI incorporates age over 60, stage III/IV, elevated LDH, ECOG performance status 2 or higher, and more than 1 extranodal site. Each adverse factor scores one point, categorizing patients into low risk (0-1), low-intermediate (2), high-intermediate (3), and high risk (4-5), with five-year overall survival ranging from eighty-three down to fifty percent.

rows: Ann Arbor Stage III or IV

steps.tx: Extremely rapid cellular doubling necessitates urgent protocol-directed multidrug chemotherapy. **Burkitt lymphoma** is a high-grade B-cell malignancy with near 100% Ki-67 proliferation and hallmark MYC translocations t(8;14), exhibiting a characteristic starry-sky histological pattern. Translocation places MYC under immunoglobulin heavy-chain enhancer control. Intensive fractionated chemotherapy like CODOX-M/IVAC or DA-EPOCH-R with aggressive hydration and rasburicase cures over eighty percent.

left.title: Burkitt Lymphoma Features
points: High risk of acute spontaneous tumor lysis syndrome

right.title: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
points: Treated primarily with R-CHOP or Pola-R-CHP

steps.tx: Genetically modified autologous T-cells provide curative salvage in chemotherapy-refractory relapse. Autologous CAR-T cell therapy **axicabtagene ciloleucel** in ZUMA-7 and lisocabtagene maraleucel in TRANSFORM established significant event-free and overall survival superiority over salvage autologous transplant in early-relapsed DLBCL. Axi-cel quadrupled median event-free survival to 8.3 months compared to 2.0 months with second-line platinum-based chemoimmunotherapy.

steps.tx: Mature B-cell lymphomas harboring characteristic cyclin alterations demonstrate distinct drug vulnerabilities. **Mantle cell lymphoma** MCL is defined by t(11;14)(q13;q32) producing cyclin D1 CCND1 nuclear overexpression, displaying high sensitivity to covalent BTK inhibitors ibrutinib and zanubrutinib. Younger fit patients receive cytarabine-containing induction followed by autologous stem cell transplantation and maintenance rituximab, while elderly patients receive bendamustine-rituximab followed by BTK targeted therapy.
